title: Schedule of Free-Look and Mid-Term Shares, Travel Protection Plans
content:
What a plan of the Travel Protection Plans gives back when cover is released, and for how long its
free-look right runs, is fixed by the plan and appears here in one place. The commission clawback figure is the
share of the agency's commission recovered on a cancellation inside the free-look period.

| Plan | Free-look period (days) | Free-look share of premium | Mid-term share of unearned premium | Commission clawback |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Trip Basics Essential | 10 | 100% | 0% | 100% |
| Trip Basics Standard | 10 | 100% | 0% | 100% |
| TripGuard Plus | 14 | 100% | 25% | 100% |
| TripGuard Premier | 14 | 100% | 50% | 100% |
| Cancel For Any Reason Elite | 15 | 100% | 50% | 100% |
| Annual Multi-Trip Traveller | 15 | 100% | 60% | 100% |
| Annual Multi-Trip Executive | 21 | 100% | 75% | 100% |

## Reading the two shares apart

The free-look share is 100% on every one of the seven plans, so the plans differ on that term only in how long
the period runs — 10 days on the two Trip Basics plans, 14 on TripGuard Plus and TripGuard Premier, 15 on
Cancel For Any Reason Elite and Annual Multi-Trip Traveller, and 21 on Annual Multi-Trip Executive.

The mid-term share is where the plans separate: nothing at all on Trip Basics Essential and Trip Basics
Standard, 25% on TripGuard Plus, 50% on TripGuard Premier and on Cancel For Any Reason Elite, 60% on Annual
Multi-Trip Traveller and 75% on Annual Multi-Trip Executive. The commission clawback stands at 100% throughout
the range.
